confidence_notes: Current [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Udaipur) and [Wise](https://wise.com/in/cost-of-living/india/udaipur) food prices are proxies for July; contributor data are sparse and meal estimates differ. Cocktail and wine estimates are uncertain, at about four times the indexed draft-beer price, informed by a [local bar menu](https://www.shamianaudaipur.com/bar-menu/). Accommodation prices are holistic monsoon-season estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Rajasthan tourist cities such as Jodhpur and Jaipur provide a regional basis, adjusted for Udaipur's lakeside tourism and July monsoon season.
